##: China edition of Qoder from qoder.com.cn; the build published from qoder.com is a different product.
The vendor only links a stable 'latest' URL; this manifest uses the timestamped path .../releases/<version>/Qoder-CN-win-x64-user.exe so cached downloads stay tied to one version.
Version and SHA-256 are read from the electron-updater feed .../releases/latest.yml, so checkver and the autoupdate hash never download the 257 MiB installer.
The NSIS installer embeds the app as $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z; the installer script expands it into $dir, which produces the flat Electron layout with "Qoder CN.exe" at the root.
This is the per-user (win-x64-user) package that the download page serves; win-x64-system is a separate artifact.

Since 0.5.11 Qoder ships a Windows Launcher: on startup PZx() reads %LOCALAPPDATA%\Qoder CN\Qoder CN Launcher\state.ini and aborts with WINDOWS_LAUNCHER_STATE_MISSING when it is absent. The NSIS installer writes it through QoderInstallerHelper.exe, which unpacking app-64.7z skips entirely. Verified unchanged in 0.5.12: cg() parses flat key=value lines and vrx() only checks installDir/appExecutable.

post_install recreates that state file as a flat key=value ini. $dir at post_install time is the 'current' junction returned by link_current, so installDir matches process.execPath of the shim and the app's vrx()/BB()/bl0() checks resolve appExecutable back to the running exe.
description: Agent workbench for human and AI software teams (China edition)
notes: The installer stubs ($PLUGINSDIR, $R8 uninstaller, uninstallerIcon.ico) are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
Startup requires "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Qoder CN\Qoder CN Launcher\state.ini", which this manifest creates during install. If it is deleted, run 'scoop reinstall qoder-cn'.
The bundled electron-updater stays enabled and downloads updates into "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\qoder-cn-updater". Prefer 'scoop update qoder-cn' so the launcher state keeps matching the app directory.
